grains.RAW.ZONES: one row per service zone (one service in one Indonesian city)
grains.RAW.ZONE_DAILY: one row per zone per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.DRIVER_DOCUMENTS: one row per zone (driver compliance document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.shortage_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(supply shortage in the zone in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day marketplace-wide unfulfilled-request FORECAST; pickup ETA ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PLAYBOOK_SEARCH over synthetic supply-shortage playbooks (one per service and shortage cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.RIDE_HAILING_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.MARKETPLACE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and playbook citations; the action memo uses only KPI, zone, shortage-cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (zones, daily unfulfilled requests, shortage hours by zone, supply-shortage risk, trip events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TRIPS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_TRIP_ALERT logs new UNFULFILLED requests to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
